content: Klap (klap.app): cloud, paste a YouTube link (or upload) and get 10+ clips in about 30 seconds; auto reframe to 9:16 focusing the most important subjects; AI captions with customizable styles; per-clip virality score; no watermark on paid output; REST API for clipping at scale; free generator tools as funnel; subscription pricing by upload minutes. YouTube-link-first workflow is its core UX.
